1.title: A Panel on The Joint Committee's Role in the Tax Legislative Process in the Past and the Future
1.description:
February 26, 2026, marks the 100th anniversary of Congress's creation of the Joint Committee on Taxation. To celebrate this anniversary, the Joint Committee on Taxation will host a panel of noted tax policy experts who will present their thoughts on the role of the Joint Committee on Taxation in the tax legislative process.

A Panel on The Joint Committee's Role in the Tax Legislative Process in the Past and the Future

Date and Time: Wednesday, March 4, 2026, 2:30 to 4:30 p.m.
Location: The Cannon Caucus Room (390 Cannon House Office Building)

Panelists:
Dave Camp- former member of Congress and Chairman of the Joint Committee on
Taxation, "JCT: A Century of Service to Congress,"

Alan Auerbach - Robert D. Burch professor of economics and law (emeritus), University
of California, Berkeley, "Economics in Academia and on Capitol Hill,"

Ajay Mehrotra- Professor of Law & History, Northwestern University Pritzker School of
Law and American Bar Foundation, "From Congressional Watchdogs to Technical
Experts: A Brief History of the Joint Committee on Taxation,"

Jon Talisman - founder and managing partner of Capitol Tax Partners and former
Assistant Secretary of the Treasury for Tax Policy, "JCT's Critical Role in
Development of Tax Policy from Several Different Vantage Points,"

David Wessel - senior fellow in Economic Studies and director of the Hutchins Center on
Fiscal and Monetary Policy at the Brookings Institution, and former reporter for the Wall
Street Journal, "JCT's Influence on the Press and the Public," and

Richard Rubin- U.S. Tax policy reporter for the Wall Street Journal, Moderator.
The panel presentation is open to the public.
